$provenance: Generated by Phase 2.4b of the desktop->web transition from the Qt sources named in 'generated_from', before sub-step 2.5 deleted them. Regenerate only by editing this file: the sources no longer exist. Every literal string was verified against the AST of the file it cites at extraction time.

data_table.name: WORKER_FILTER_THRESHOLD_ROWS
data_table.rationale: Frames above this many rows filter off the UI thread; below it the filter runs inline. A real end-to-end run confirmed the figure.

data_table.name: COLUMN_WIDTH_SAMPLE_ROWS
data_table.rationale: Column auto-size samples only the first N rows rather than O(rows x columns) calls into the model.

data_table.name: MAX_COLUMN_WIDTH_PX
data_table.rationale: Auto-sized columns are clamped to this width.

data_table.name: COLUMN_WIDTH_PADDING_PX
data_table.rationale: Added to the widest of header + sampled cells.

data_table.name: COLUMN_CHOOSER_THRESHOLD_COLUMNS
data_table.rationale: Above this many columns a column chooser is offered instead of rendering every column.

data_table.name: ROW_HEIGHT_PX
data_table.rationale: Fixed row height; alternating row colours are on.

status_bar.name: DEFAULT_MESSAGE_TIMEOUT_MS
status_bar.rationale: Dwell time of a transient status message.

settings_dialog_ranges.rationale: The default (5) lives in uadas_core/core/config.py; the BOUNDS exist only here -- config validation type-checks and does not range-check.

Floor 10 = ThemeTokens.with_base_font_size's smallest-legible floor (minus the -1 sm offset it derives); ceiling 24 = ThemeTokens.font_size_lg doubled -- a generous but bounded upper end for 'text resize to 200%' (WCAG 1.4.4).

guidance.name: MAX_SUGGESTIONS_SHOWN
guidance.rationale: Matches every other 'small, session-scoped list' cap; a longer list would crowd the guidance card zone.

rules: MetricSection value is bold at +4pt, with an optional caption; card title is bold +2pt.
AssumptionsSection renders bulleted visually but '; '-joined for the screen reader.
TableSection hides the vertical header and auto-sizes its columns.

chat_panel.name: NO_PROVIDER_TEXT
chat_panel.value: No AI provider configured — add one in Settings.
chat_panel.rationale: Shown when no AI provider is configured.

chat_panel_decision: Colour was REMOVED from status rows: the glyph plus the accessible name already carry the distinction (WCAG 1.4.1 -- colour is never the sole signal).

icons.name: RENDER_SCALE
icons.rationale: Icons render at this multiple for crispness.

icons.name: COLOR_PLACEHOLDER
icons.rationale: Token in the SVG that is substituted with the theme colour; native CSS currentColor in a browser.

qss_component_metrics.source: resources/styles/base.qss.template (deleted in 2.5; line numbers are an audit trail)
qss_component_metrics.note: Hardcoded component metrics from the Qt stylesheet. Everything else in that template is tokenised: colours, font sizes, radii (radius_sm/radius_md), the focus ring (focus_ring, focus_ring_width) and the spacing scale -- space_1..space_5 are DERIVED by ThemeTokens.space(step) in uadas_core/theme/tokens.py from the active Density (comfortable / cozy / compact), not stored as fields. Only the values below were literals in the template.
qss_component_metrics.min_target_size_rationale: 'min-height 24px satisfies WCAG 2.2 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).' Applied to QPushButton, QToolButton, date/time edits, check boxes and radio buttons, list/tree/table rows, tabs and scrollbar handles.

metrics.note: Half the 16px indicator, so it renders as a circle.
Sized for the single-line rows of the table and tree views.

Guidance suggestions carry two lines (title + rationale); the shared 24px row height clipped the rationale. Scoped by object name so it widens only this list, not every list, tree and table in the application.
The accent bar on the stage result area.

icon_rule: Danger actions pass tokens.danger so colour is never the only signal (WCAG 1.4.1). A missing icon degrades to nothing and warns once -- it must not crash the UI.

theme_defaults.note: Reduced motion is orthogonal to colour and density and has no QSS representation: it is a plain bool, emitted as its own signal rather than bundled into theme_changed, so toggling it does not force every listener to re-render.

empty_state_illustration_defaults.rule: Illustrations get a real accessible description rather than being hidden as decorative -- a deliberate departure from the usual empty-alt guidance.
